rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty about TE uniformity/cohesiveness and zona thinning from this single image; some described details are not clearly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, DOR/AMH, BMI, prior IVF failure, sperm motility, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear progression from morphology to prognosis and recommendations; minor issues include somewhat additive probability adjustments and a few speculative links.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, transfer rationale, and lifestyle counseling, but includes less guideline-supported suggestions such as ERA after limited failure, growth hormone, calcium ionophore, and broad adjunctive testing.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, lifestyle modification, and future planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
